safety_emergency_closure_005.evidence: The principal at each school shall disseminate a simple but precise plan which outlines tasks, in detail, to be performed by the bargaining unit members. ... The principal or principal's designee will immediately call the appropriate District Office emergency telephone number ... Designate a telephone team to maintain phone communications ... Principals should not commit bargaining unit members to a physical confrontation or hazard ... lock up the gates and/or the buildings should it be necessary to close the school.
